name: new_default_3d
description: TitanCell v42.5 3D nuclear instance segmentation using watershed, high-mask fraction filtering, flow divergence, and shell merging.

settings.label: Cell diameter (px)
settings.tooltip: Master cell size in pixels (like Cellpose diameter). When changed, all parameters below are auto-populated with derived values. The user can then tweak any parameter before running. Typical: small=60, medium=80-100, large=120.

settings.label: Mask threshold
settings.tooltip: Base probability threshold for binary foreground mask. Lower = more sensitive (more cells, more false positives). Higher = stricter (fewer cells, fewer false positives).

settings.label: Center smooth sigma (px)
settings.tooltip: Gaussian smoothing applied to center heatmap before NMS peak detection. Lower = sharper peaks (more seeds, risk over-splitting). Higher = smoother (fewer seeds, risk merging touching cells).

settings.label: Center peak threshold
settings.tooltip: Minimum center heatmap value for a peak to become a Tier-1 seed. Lower = more sensitive (more seeds). Higher = stricter (fewer, stronger seeds).

settings.label: Min seed distance (px)
settings.tooltip: Minimum distance between center peaks in XY pixels (anisotropy-adjusted). Lower = allow closer seeds (split touching cells). Higher = suppress nearby seeds (merge touching cells).

settings.label: Min island volume (Tier-2)
settings.tooltip: Minimum volume (voxels) for an unseeded SDF island to receive a Tier-2 gap-fill seed. Too low = noise seeds. Too high = miss small real cells.

settings.label: Height center weight
settings.tooltip: Weight of center heatmap in watershed height map. Higher = stronger basins at cell centers (deeper wells). Lower = less center influence.

settings.label: Height divergence weight
settings.tooltip: Weight of flow divergence in watershed height map. Raise (0.8-1.0) to split touching cells more aggressively. Lower (0.2-0.4) to reduce over-splitting. Set 0.0 to disable divergence entirely.

settings.label: Boundary shell depth (px)
settings.tooltip: Depth in pixels of the shell mask applied to the boundary signal in the height map. Only the outer shell of each cell contributes to boundary elevation. Lower = thinner shell = more boundary exposed.

settings.label: Watershed downsample XY
settings.tooltip: Downsample factor for watershed in XY. 2 = ~4x faster, slightly coarser boundaries. 1 = full resolution, slower but precise boundaries.

settings.label: Shell merge depth (px)
settings.tooltip: SDF depth threshold for identifying the deep interior zone where shell merging operates. Peaks within the same deep interior region may be merged if close enough.

settings.label: Shell merge max distance (px)
settings.tooltip: Maximum anisotropy-weighted distance (px) for two peaks in the same deep interior to be merged. Lower = only merge very close peaks. Higher = merge more distant peaks.

settings.label: High mask threshold
settings.tooltip: Voxel-level mask probability threshold for 'definitely cell' classification. The high-mask fraction filter counts what fraction of each instance's voxels exceed this. Real cells have many voxels above 0.96; background has few.

settings.label: Min high-mask fraction
settings.tooltip: Minimum fraction of instance voxels that must exceed the high mask threshold to be kept. Real cells: 30-80%. Background leakage: 0-5%. Raise (0.10-0.15) to remove more false positives. Lower (0.02-0.03) to keep more small cells.

settings.label: Min cell volume (vox)
settings.tooltip: Minimum volume in voxels for a final instance to be kept. Removes tiny noise objects. Lower = keep smaller cells. Higher = remove more small objects.

settings.label: SDF boundary sigma (px)
settings.tooltip: Exponential decay rate for converting SDF to boundary surface probability. Lower = sharper boundary. Higher = smoother boundary falloff.

settings.label: SDF max distance (px)
settings.tooltip: Maximum SDF distance for tanh scaling. Controls the range over which the SDF signal is spread. Larger = more gradual SDF transition.
